definitions.outcomes: Valid ASK, valid GUESS, INVALID and other partition turns. Truncated and empty are overlapping flags. A second partition gives truncation priority.
definitions.invalid_heavy: At least half the counted questions returned INVALID. This overlaps terminal causes.
definitions.zero_eig: Valid primary questions with EIG < 1e-12. Constant full-table predicates are separate from predicates constant only after noiseless elimination.
definitions.cost_bridge: Change turn count at forecast lengths, then actual input lengths, then actual output lengths, then measured cache credit, then per-call upward rounding. Invalid cost is an observed subset, not an additive bridge term.
